title: Wire Skill Issue™
summary: When a connection fails and the wire is immediately accused of lacking professional development.
definition: A condition in which an electrical connection fails, but instead of investigating the contact resistance, the engineer assigns blame to the wire's competence.
root_cause: Probably the connection. Definitely the wire's fault. 😭😭😭
origin: The Department of Premature Electrical Judgment
examples: The LED still refuses to turn on. Classic wire skill issue.
